name: baseline
description: Single-user baseline -- measures 'how long one trade takes with the system idle'. It is the denominator for all later comparisons and the input for deriving concurrency targets. Without it, 'P95 got 30% slower' means nothing.
_sample_size: WARNING: sample count = VUs x duration / time-per-iteration. At 20s per iteration, 300s yields only 15 samples and P95 is completely meaningless. Check the sample-size warning in the summary after the run; if too few, add -e DURATION=1800s.
